research_question: Can frozen, ground-truth-free descriptor-map statistics predict the sign/direction of the benefit of a specified aggregator relative to equal_mean for unseen images?

hypotheses.preoutcome_feature: mean of pairwise Pearson correlations between three descriptor score maps

measures.score: F1 with native-ground-truth-geometry one-to-one maximal-cardinality matcher; do not substitute official Berkeley metrics
measures.comparison: delta_F1(candidate)-delta_F1(equal_mean) is shorthand; actual outcome is F1(candidate)-F1(equal_mean) on the same image and fixed evaluator
measures.postprocessing: NMS; suppression identity; legacy_sigmoid calibration; identical interface between candidate and control
measures.threshold_selection: training/calibration cohort only; parameter values and code SHA frozen before opening confirmatory GT
measures.repeats: If folds/repetitions are used, average per original image before analysis. No pseudoreplication

cohort.eligibility: Two datasets/domains selected and committed before analyzing any confirmatory outcome; original images with GT, necessary descriptor support, same fixed evaluator, no discovery/test overlap
cohort.selection: Deterministic hash-sorted eligible image list from declared versioned dataset manifests; exclusions based only on prespecified technical criteria without seeing F1
cohort.exclusion: Exclude 14 UDED discovery images; any prior Stage23/24 model development/selection/evaluation exposure, exact content duplicates and manually reviewed near duplicates; document each exclusion
cohort.power_analysis: Design target 150 is provisional; validate power and domain mix prior to freeze; do not revise after any confirmatory outcomes

inference.test: one-sided Spearman rank association with permutation p-value
inference.multiplicity: Holm step-down across the two primary p-values
inference.ties: midranks; permute outcomes across independent images; if stratified by design, restrict permutation within domains and preregister the variant before freeze
inference.uncertainty: image-level stratified bootstrap 95% CI for rho; inference remains Holm permutation p values
inference.missing_data: Reject missing, NaN, or incomplete maps/GT; report exclusion, no outcome-dependent filtering
inference.effect_size_report: rho, 95% CI, unadjusted and Holm-adjusted p; per-domain diagnostics
inference.secondary_analysis: Domain-specific rho and influence analysis as exploratory, not additional primary tests

adaptive_selector.gate: Only propose evaluation after H1/H2 confirmatory analysis; separate held-out set never used to choose features, operators or hyperparameters
adaptive_selector.comparator: best fixed operator selected on training data, selected single descriptor, equal_mean
adaptive_selector.evaluation: pre-locked paired image-level comparison and CI entirely on untouched test data; oracle is only a ceiling

freeze_requirements: Select and identify the two datasets/domains and manifest versions
Document previous-exposure audit including Stage23/24 BSDS validation and 14 UDED images
Lock image IDs, source SHA256 and exact technical exclusions
Fix code SHA/commit for score generation, feature extraction, evaluator and threshold selection
Calculate and document power/sensitivity before any outcome inspection
Change protocol status to frozen only through a separately reviewed commit
